newsitem.title: USA: Odwalla not ascertained financial cost.
newsitem.headline: Odwalla not ascertained financial cost.

text.p: Odwalla Inc founder and chairman Greg Steltenpohl said on Monday he did not know the impact on its first quarter results of a recall of many of the company's fruit juice products caused by links to E-Coli bacteria.
He told reporters in Denver the company was not focusing on the financial cost of the problem, but rather trying to resolve the issue.
Odwalla's first fiscal quarter ends Nov 30 and the recall, which has been completed, began last week.
He told a press conference in Denver that the company was still selling citrus products and bottled water but said he did not know to what level revenues have decreased.
In the 1995 first fiscal quarter the company reported a loss of $0.02 a share on revenues of $12.4 million, which were some 97 percent above the prior year.
He said the company believes it has good product liability insurance and it was financially solvent.
Odwalla shares took a severe beating on Wall Street last week, but the stock was up 3/8 at 13-3/8 on Monday.
